name: Krishna Ventures Limited
about: Krishna Ventures Limited offers engineering solutions in the form of products and services in the area of HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning) steel fabrication, solar structure, and pre engineered buildings. It manufactures, assembles, deals, merchants, imports, and agents for the purchase, sale and hiring of air conditioners, air conditioning and refrigeration, machinery, refrigerants, liquids and gases, ice cream freezers, quick freezing cabinets, deodorisers, refrigerated trucks, vans, wagons, heaters, heating appliances, coolers, diffusers, compressors, condensers, fans, pumps, motors, thermostats, sprayers, cold storages or ice cream plants, appliances, tools, machinery apparatuses, devices, instruments, chemicals, machinery, equipments, appliances and instruments and their parts. The company was formerly known as Multifarious Trading and Agencies Ltd and changed its name to Krishna Ventures Limited in June 2010. Krishna Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Noida, India.
